content.short: Obvious is a mobile-only smart contract wallet that enables users to transact crypto seamlessly.
content.description: Obvious is an account abstraction-based smart wallet for Ethereum that lets you pay gas fees with ERC-20 tokens of your choice and execute complex, multi-step transactions with a single click. The app supports sending, receiving, bridging, and cross-chain swaps across 17 chains right inside the wallet. Available on the App Store and Play Store, Obvious also includes a built-in portfolio tracker, transaction notifications, and the ability to connect multiple wallets and watchlist addresses.
content.meta: Obvious is a mobile-only wallet on Ethereum that lets you pay gas with ERC-20 tokens. Discover Obvious and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
